content: Hey love, how was your day? I kept thinking about you during my meetings. I hope you weren't too stressed at work.
Hi! My day was okay, just a bit hectic, as usual. Your message really brightened it up though.
You always work so hard. I really admire your dedication. One day soon, you'll be able to take a break and enjoy the good life with me, just like we talked about.
That sounds wonderful. I really do trust you, you've been such a positive influence for me lately.

And I trust you too, more than anyone. That's why I want to share something important with you. I just finalized a huge contract overseas, but there's a temporary hold on my payment because of some licensing paperwork. It's frustrating.
Oh no, that sounds stressful. Is there anything I can do to help?
Honestly, just talking to you helps. But there is something, if I can pay the attorney's processing fee this week, the contract will be released and I'll get my funds. It's just a short-term issue.
That sounds unfair. How much do you need to pay? Is there a way I can help you with this?
It's $3,800 for the documentation and license. If you could lend it to me, I'll pay you back as soon as the funds clear, plus 20%. I'd never ask if it wasn't urgent. You know how much you mean to me.
That's a lot of money, but I trust you. How should I send it to you?

Thank you, darling. You have no idea how much this means. The lawyer prefers payment via Zelle for speed. Can you send it to this email: goldberg.legal.assist@gmail.com? Let me know if you need help with the process.
I have Zelle on my phone. Should I send it all at once or in parts?
All at once is best so there's no delay, but if you're more comfortable splitting it, that's okay too. Whatever works for you. I promise, you'll have it back within days.
Okay, I'll send it now. Please confirm when you get it.
You're incredible. I'll stay by my phone to confirm. Thank you for believing in me, I won't let you down. We're in this together.
Sent! Please let me know as soon as it arrives.
I just received it! You're amazing. I'll keep you updated every step of the way. Soon, we'll celebrate together. Thank you for your trust, love.
